inputs.description: A list of `tf.Tensor` or `tf.IndexedSlices` objects, each with the same shape and type. `tf.IndexedSlices` objects will be converted into dense tensors prior to adding.

constraints: The name parameter is optional and specifies a name for the operation.

output.description: A `tf.Tensor` of the same shape and type as the elements of `inputs`.

constraints: Inputs to add_n must be a list of tensors or IndexedSlices with the same shape and type.
